0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>The light-hearted hunter is eager to see what you can do.

25.original: Use the leather sack on a weakened Greatwood rail.

26.original: Deliver the bulging leather sack to the light-hearted hunter.

48.original: Well met, ally of Ronka. Did you hear? Almet's recently returned with an astounding catch.

49.original: She slew five Greatwood rails single-handedly. <hex:021A020203>Five<hex:021A020103>.

50.original: Almet is without question one of our greatest hunters, but I am most curious to see how you would fare against them. If you would take up the challenge, meet with me at the Great Pyramid of Ux'ner.

51.original: You have come. Very good! I care not for how many you can capture, only how it is done. When you have weakened one, use this sack to capture it and bring it back here.

52.original: Good luck in your hunt. I will be watching.

53.original: I can see now why Almet speaks so highly of you. Your form was unlike anything I have ever seen. But what of the Greatwood rail?

54.original: You have done well not to bruise the feathers or the skin. We can make good use of this.

55.original: Yes, such a prize warrants a reward. Meet with me at Fanow and I will see you compensated for your trouble.

56.original: For you, oh great hunter, and ally of Ronka.

57.original: I will see this to Almet and─

58.original: <gasp> She will ask where is <hex:021A020203>my<hex:021A020103> quarry!

59.original: What a fool I am. I should have been hunting with you. Perhaps if I can hunt four and offer them together with yours...
